Parliamentary Committees reshuffle: TMC loses chairperson posts

The Trinamool Congress (TMC) has lost the chairpersonship of two key Parliamentary Committees. The Parliamentary Committee on Commerce, previously headed by TMC Rajya Sabha MP Dola Sen, will now be led by BJP Rajya Sabha MP Sudhanshu Trivedi.
